fact_text: Return on equity is earnings per share divided by book value per share, so an investor can recompute it from the balance sheet and income statement instead of relying on ready-made ratios.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: ROE should be judged over at least five years, not one year, because a single strong year can hide losses in other years; consistency of positive returns matters more than one peak.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: When ROE falls in one year, check whether the cause was management mismanagement or external factors such as super tax, government policy, interest rates, taxes or politics, using the corporate briefing and peers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: An expected ROE for the coming year can be roughly estimated by carrying the latest reported quarter's EPS forward for the remaining quarters, then adjusting for interest rates, government policy and receivable payments.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Book value grows by the earnings a company retains, so it can be forecast as EPS multiplied by the retention ratio, where retention is one minus the payout ratio.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: When losses have shrunk equity, a small profit can make ROE look artificially high, so a high ROE after a run of losses should be read with caution.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Screening narrows the market in steps: about 500 listed companies are filtered by ROE to roughly 40 high-ROE names, then to two or three candidates after checking other ratios and risks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: A company can be high quality yet a poor investment if its share price is already high, because the investor's return depends on the price paid relative to earnings, not on business quality alone.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Company size is measured by market capitalisation, not by share price, so a stock with a high rupee price is not necessarily from a larger company than one with a low price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Dividing annual EPS by the share price gives an earnings yield that can be compared with fixed-deposit rates to judge whether a stock's return justifies its price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Knowing how P/E and price-to-book are derived lets an investor recalculate them from financial statements and interpret them, rather than memorising which values are good or bad.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: The analyst's approach combines an ROE screen with price-to-book, debt-to-equity and a seven-point checklist, so no single ratio decides the stock choice.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Hub Power's ROE was about 32% in 2020, 30% in 2021, 22% in 2022, 36% in 2023 and 33% in 2024, averaging around 30% over five years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: The analyst's rough estimate of Hub Power's ROE for 2025 was about 28%, offered as an approximation rather than a precise forecast.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Complete Blueprint to Find Highest Return Stocks in 30 Minutes | Afaque Manzar | PSX Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-02-21)

fact_text: Hub Power paid out about 37% of its 2024 earnings as dividends.

fact_text: Hub Power signed an agreement with PSO to install EV charging at PSO's fuel pump stations, a new business the analyst says will need additional capital.

fact_text: The analyst said Hub Power's push into EV charging and sustainable energy is capital-intensive, so funding needs could weigh on book value growth and future returns.

fact_text: For IPPs such as Hub Power, government payments on receivables and interest rates flow into the income statement and balance sheet, so payment timing shapes reported ROE.

fact_text: Nestle Pakistan's ROE ran at about 225% in 2019, 212% in 2020, 236% in 2021 and 260% in 2022, then fell to about 155% in 2023.

fact_text: Nestle Pakistan's 2024 earnings per share were about 326 rupees, the figure the analyst used for its earnings yield.

fact_text: Nestle Pakistan's share price was quoted at about 7,250 to 7,300 rupees on the video date, with very thin trading volume.

fact_text: Nestle's share price was about 7,000 in 2019 too, so the analyst saw little capital appreciation over the period despite its strong ROE.

fact_text: The analyst regarded Nestle as a high-quality company whose bottled water business earns strong margins, which drives its high ROE, but as expensive for a new investor at the quoted price.
